value.body: English as a major studies literature written in English — British, American, Indian and world writing in translation — along with literary theory, the basics of linguistics, and academic writing. Some courses add papers in journalism, translation or communication.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG, where the subject itself can be one of the tests counted; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Some universities fix the major at admission; others, under the NEP four-year programme, let students settle it after the first year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Reading and writing load is heavy; most assessment is by essays and close reading of texts.
Graduate jobs are spread across content writing, editing, publishing, media, corporate communications and teaching.
School teaching needs a B.Ed; college teaching usually needs an M.A. plus UGC-NET or a Ph.D.
Strong English helps in civil-services and bank exams, which test the language, but the degree is not required for them.
